metadata.title: Frequently Asked Questions | El Sembrador
metadata.description: Find answers to the most common questions about orders, shipping, payments, products, and accounts at El Sembrador. Everything you need to know for your shopping experience.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions

items.question: How can I place an order?
items.answer: To place an order, simply browse our product catalog, add the products you want to your shopping cart, and follow the checkout process. You will need to create an account or sign in if you already have one.

items.question: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
items.answer: You can modify or cancel your order within 2 hours of placing it. To do so, contact our customer service team as soon as possible with your order number.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Delivery times vary depending on your location. Generally, deliveries to urban areas take 2 to 5 business days, while rural areas may take 5 to 10 business days. You will receive a tracking number when your order is shipped.

items.question: Do you ship nationwide?
items.answer: Yes, we ship throughout the country. Shipping costs are automatically calculated during checkout based on your location.

items.question: Can I pick up my order at a branch?
items.answer: Yes, you can pick up your order at one of our branches at no additional cost. During checkout, select the 'Pick up at branch' option and choose the most convenient location.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), bank transfers, and cash payments through our secure payment system.

items.question: Is it safe to pay online?
items.answer: Yes, we use SSL encryption technology to protect all payment information. We also work with certified payment providers that meet the highest security standards.

items.question: What warranty do your products have?
items.answer: All our products are covered by a warranty against manufacturing defects. The warranty period varies by product and is specified in its description. For veterinary products, please check the specific conditions.

items.question: Can I return a product?
items.answer: Yes, we accept returns within 7 days of receiving the product, provided it is unused and in its original packaging. Veterinary and perishable products have special conditions.

items.question: How can I change my password?
items.answer: To change your password, sign in to your account, go to 'Login', and select the 'Forgot your password?' option. You will receive a confirmation email once the change is successful.

items.question: How can I delete my account?
items.answer: If you wish to delete your account, please contact our customer service team. Keep in mind that deleting your account will result in losing access to your purchase history and accumulated points.
